### (7) Baselines

`scripts/_mechanism_delta/detect_ci.py:33-40`: `test_helper` = `tests/_*.py` (20 entries, `.github/mechanism-baseline.json`); `ci_gate` = `scripts/check_*.py` files + workflow `run:` steps; `autouse_fixture` keys are `autouse_fixture::<path>::<name>` (142). E10 creates no `tests/_*.py`, no check script, no workflow step, so `new=0` for those kinds; Makefile lines are not censused. The only autouse fixtures in E10's touch set: `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_backend_scalar_surface{,_heldout}.py::_clean` (identical bodies — the merge keeps the base key, the heldout key buckets `stale`), `tests/unit/test_audit_serve.py::_clean_ui_env` (base, unchanged), `tests/unit/test_prompt_repo_root_seam.py::_clear_caches` (kept in place). `--check` exits 0 with `stale>0` (`scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py:51-57`); `--update-stale` is maintenance-only and must not be run. `.github/complexity-baseline.json` covers `PRODUCTION_SCOPE = "src/rebar"` only (`scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py:94`); the module-size gate is `find src/rebar` (`_build-and-test.yml:604-640`) — merged test modules above 800 LOC (e.g. `test_fixture_admission.py` 460+694) trip nothing.

For this story: `tests/unit/test_audit_serve.py::_clean_ui_env` is base-only and unchanged by the merge, so no autouse key changes here; the `_clean` key that buckets `stale` belongs to S2 (cepevorous-garlicky-leopard). `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` reports `new=0` and `.github/mechanism-baseline.json` is not edited.

## Context / Problem
39 modules directly under `tests/unit/` have a `<name>_heldout.py` twin. Once both oracles have been reviewed the split only doubles module count, duplicates identical helper definitions, and makes every rename touch two files. Across these 39 pairs exactly one test-function name collides (`tests/unit/test_plan_material_pin_config_heldout.py::test_unreadable_optional_config_warns_structurally_and_returns_false`, semantically identical to base `:20-31`) and 8 pairs carry helper/fixture/class definitions with differing bodies; every other colliding definition is identical. The pair list with per-pair rename sets, filtered from enumeration (2) of the test-suite epic's first comment, is itemised in this ticket's first comment. This story starts only after the test-suite epic's last story (E10a-S5, defectible-befuddling-sheldrake) and every code epic of this release that edits `tests/` are closed, because those epics edit these twin modules; its blocking links record that. Cites are on origin/main 083620b0.

## Approach
Directory: `tests/unit/` root — 39 pairs, 9 renames (8 pairs whose differing definitions take the `_heldout` suffix, plus the one test-name collision, resolved by deleting the held-out file). For each pair: `cat` the held-out module into the base under a `# ── held-out oracles (merged from <name>_heldout.py) ──` divider; keep the base module docstring and append the held-out docstring's "what it proves" paragraph; dedupe identical definitions (`pytestmark` counts here — keep the base copy); rename differing definitions and repoint their callers; `git rm` the held-out file. Rename rule: suffix the HELD-OUT definition `_heldout` (e.g. `_load_heldout`) and repoint its callers; keep the base copy of identical definitions. Exception: `tests/unit/test_plan_material_pin_config_heldout.py` (24 LOC) is deleted whole — its single test duplicates base `:20-31`, so nothing is appended to `tests/unit/test_plan_material_pin_config.py`. No test body changes.

## Scope
In scope: the 39 base modules directly under `tests/unit/` named in the first comment and their 39 `_heldout` twins. Out of scope: every pair under `tests/unit/{metrics,workflow,rebar_reconciler}` (S2), `tests/interfaces/` and `tests/integration/` (S3), `tests/scripts/` (S4), the 78 unpaired held-out renames (S5), every file under `src/`, and any test body change.

## Testing
Per pair: `pytest --collect-only -q <base> <heldout>` before and `pytest --collect-only -q <base>` after — counts equal (both recorded on this ticket); `pytest <base>` green. `make test` green.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Zero paired twins remain in this directory: for each of the 39 pairs `git ls-files tests/unit/<base>_heldout.py` prints nothing (the unpaired `_heldout` modules in this directory are untouched here and renamed in S5).
- [ ] Per-pair node counts reconcile: each merged base collects exactly the sum of the two prior counts, from the before/after `pytest --collect-only -q` runs recorded on this ticket.
- [ ] `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` shows `new=0` (`tests/unit/test_audit_serve.py::_clean_ui_env` is base-only and stays; the one `_clean` autouse key that buckets `stale` belongs to S2).
- [ ] `make verify` green.
